name: ListPackageJobs

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range during which the jobs to be queried were created. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的起始时间。格式为: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_of_create_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range during which the jobs to be queried were created. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的结束时间。格式为: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_of_create_time

parameters.help_en:
The state of the job.

Init: The job is submitted.

Success: The job is successful.

Fail: The job failed
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。

Init：已提交
Success：成功
Fail：失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The order that you use to sort the query results. Valid values:

CreateTimeDesc: sorts the jobs by creation time in descending order.

CreateTimeAsc: sorts the jobs by creation time in ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序顺序。目前只支持两种：
CreateTimeDesc：按创建时间降序
CreateTimeAsc：按创建时间升序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 连续分页查询时下一页的标记（第一页没有）
parameters.name: next_page_token
